100.$description: Default duration. Pick the step that matches the size and emphasis of the motion.

1300.$description: Longer duration step. Use for one-shot sequences (e.g. the animated logo boot).

fast.$description: Frame period for stepped graphic motion, 12fps (on twos). Use for redraws that follow the pointer; not for UI transitions.

default.$description: Default frame period for stepped graphic motion, 8fps (on threes). Use for dissolves, scans and lighting changes; not for UI transitions.

slow.$description: Frame period for stepped graphic motion, 6fps (on fours). Use for ambient drift; not for UI transitions.

tick.$description: Frame period for stepped graphic motion, 3fps (on eights). Use for palette cycles and slow ramps; not for UI transitions.

easeIn.$description: Ease-in curve. Use for elements leaving the viewport — slow start, accelerating exit.

easeInOut.$description: Ease-in-out curve. Use for movements that both originate and settle on screen (e.g. expansions in place).

easeOut.$description: Ease-out curve. Use for elements entering the viewport — fast start, gentle settle.

emphasized.$description: Emphasised easing curve. Use for transitions that should feel more expressive (e.g. brand-led page transitions, hero reveal motion).
